newsitem.title: USA: Sandoz says FDA okays Tavist for colds.
newsitem.headline: Sandoz says FDA okays Tavist for colds.

text.p: Sandoz AG's Sandoz Pharmaceuticals Corp unit said on Thursday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved the company's labeling of its Tavist-D and Tavist-1 medication as effective in relieving cold symptoms.

Tavist was introduced in 1992 as an over-the-counter treatment for sinus and allergy symptoms. "While we know that many consumers already take Tavist for cold symptoms, the approval allows the product to now incorporate this claim on its new labeling," said Mark Gelbert, Sandoz Pharmaceuticals executive director of scientific affairs.
